definitions.short: Shelomith , the name of five Israelites and three Israelitesses
definitions.full: H8019. Shlomiyth II. שְׁלֹמִית proper name, feminine Σαλ ( ω ) μιθ , etc.: 1 in Israel Lev 24:11 . 2 daughter of Zerubbabel 1Chr 3:19 .

occurrences.englishText: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;
The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.
The sons of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.

All that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth, and of his brothers.
After her, he took Maacah the daughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
Of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him one hundred sixty males.
